This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER
This is first application under Section 438 of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973 for grant of anticipatory bail.

The applicant is apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No.395/2022 registered at Police Station Makdon, District Ujjain (MP) for offence punishable under Sections 420,
467 and 468 of the IPC.

2. As per the prosecution, a written complaint was made by the complainant on 26.10.2021 to the effect that Nagar Parishad, Makdon, District Ujjain had invited tender on 07.09.2016 for auction of 44 shops.
In the tender the complainant had deposited a total sum of Rs.7,84,500/- by way of earnest money and had sought allotment of shop Nos.47 and 62.
The process of tender was cancelled due to which Nagar Parishad Makdon had to refund all the deposited amount to the prospective tenderers.

The other co-accused person submitted forged applications along with affidavit before the Nagar Parishad allegedly having been made by the complainant to the effect that Mukesh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/30026733/
1

sentences.text: the amount which has to be refunded to him be instead refunded to co-accused.
Relying upon the said application and affidavit the amount has been paid to the co- accused persons.

On the allegation that applicant had purchased the stamp on which the affidavit was eventually executed which was submitted before the Nagar Parishad, Makdon, he has been implicated for the present offence.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.
There is no allegation against him that he purchased the stamp in his own name or executed any affidavit which was submitted to the Nagar Parishad, Makdon.
His role is limited only to the purchase of the stamp and nothing more.
There is no allegation against the applicant of in any manner being personally involved in misappropriation of the amount of the complainant or that he has received any amount.
The applicant undertakes to cooperate in the investigation and shall appear before the Investigating Officer as and when directed.
On such grounds prayer for grant of benefit of anticipatory bail to the applicant has been made.

4. The aforesaid prayer has been opposed by the learned counsel for the respondent/State as well as the learned counsel for the objector submitting that in view of the allegations levelled against the applicant he does not deserve to be granted the benefit of anticipatory bail.
5. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and have perused the case- diary.
6. The allegation against the applicant is of purchasing the stamp on which the affidavit was executed which has been submitted to the Nagar Parishad, Makdon.
There is no allegation against the applicant of himself swearing the affidavit or in any other manner executing the same.
There does not appear to any allegation against him of personally financially benefiting in the matter.
The case is based on documentary evidence which evidence is on record in view of which custodial interrogation of the applicant does not appear to be necessary.
The applicant has undertaken to cooperate in the investigation.
Thus in view of the available facts of the case, I deem it fit to grant the benefit of anticipatory bail to the applicant.

7. It is directed that in the event of arrest of applicant by the Arresting Officer, he shall be released on bail subject to his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer (Investigating Officer).
8.
The applicant shall make himself available for interrogation by a Police Officer, as and when required.
Applicant shall further abide by the other conditions enumerated in Sub Section (2) of Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.
9. The applicant shall appear before the Investigating Officer as and when directed and shall extend full cooperation in the investigation.
He shall also deposit a sum of Rs. 2 Lakhs before the Court concerned within a period of two months from today under protest.
In case of his failure to do so this order shall automatically come to an end.
